records.label: spacr.utils.measure_test_mode#2
records.source: Only visible ``.npy`` arrays are sampled, so a macOS ``._`` sidecar is never measured in place of a field. The folder's ``.spacr_plane_layout.json`` is copied across as well when it exists: it is what says which plane is which, and a ``test/merged`` without it is read as a legacy folder, against the default plane order.
records.context: Only visible ``.npy`` arrays are sampled, so a macOS ``._`` sidecar is never measured in place of a microscope field of view. The folder's ``.spacr_plane_layout.json`` is copied across as well when it exists: it is what says which image layer is which, and a ``test/merged`` without it is read as a legacy folder, against the default image layer order.
records.translation: Aðeins sýnileg ``.npy`` fylki eru tekin í úrtak, svo macOS ``._`` fylgiskrá er aldrei mæld í stað sjónsviðs. ``.spacr_plane_layout.json`` möppunnar er einnig afrituð yfir þegar hún er til: hún segir hvaða myndlag er hvað, og ``test/merged`` án hennar er lesin sem eldri mappa, eftir sjálfgefinni röð myndlaga.
